name: archive-librarian
description: The curatorial agent for thread-archive: the /librarian skill (curate conversations), the /gardener skill (tend the topic graph), the librarian's one-thread-at-a-time enforcement hook, and the librarian write MCP server. Requires a thread-archive install (the archive-librarian-mcp console script) and the read server (archive-mcp) wired into the client.
